title: Degree-zero sections of the sheaf Hom complex compute homotopy classes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with Grothendieck topology $J$, $\mathcal R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $U\in\mathcal C$, and $L,I$ arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal R$-modules. Put $S=\Gamma(U,\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I))$ using [def-pur-hom-complex], with its specified projections $\pi$. Let $\mathrm{res}$ be termwise restriction to $\mathcal C/U$ and $q$ the quotient to the homotopy category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. There exist equivalences $e:Z^0(S)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{Ch}(\mathcal R_U)}(L|_U,I|_U)$ and $a:H^0(S)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal R_U)}(q(L|_U),q(I|_U))$ such that the components of $e(z)$ are exactly the evaluations of $\pi$ on the included cocycle $z$, and $a([z])=q(e(z))$. No K-injectivity, boundedness, or derived-category hypothesis is assumed.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-localized-hom-complex-cycles-aux] to obtain the cocycle equivalence e and its canonical component formula he.

Apply [lem-pur-localized-hom-complex-homology-aux] to that e and he to obtain a and the formula on representatives. Pair the two results, preserving every component equality in the original statement.

theorem localizedHomComplex_homotopy
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hzero : Functor.PreservesZeroMorphisms
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let H := homComplex (R := R) L I
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    let S := ((SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H
    letI := hzero
    let res : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} R₀) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) ℤ :=
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ e : S.cycles 0 ≃ (res.obj L ⟶ res.obj I),
      (∀ (z : S.cycles 0) (p : ℤ) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
        ((e z).f p).val.app W =
          (((π L I 0 p p (add_zero p)).val.app (op U)) (S.iCycles 0 z)).app W) ∧
      ∃ a : S.homology 0 ≃ (q.obj (res.obj L) ⟶ q.obj (res.obj I)),
        ∀ z : S.cycles 0, a (S.homologyπ 0 z) = q.map (e z)
